shortBio.en: Rush drummer/lyricist from 1974; large kit, odd meters, sci-fi/humanist lyrics.
shortBio.zh: 1974 起 Rush 鼓手/作词；大鼓组、奇数拍、科幻/人文歌词。

body.en:
Born 1952. Joins 1974 replacing Rutsey. 2112 through Moving Pictures set prog-drum teaching objects. Dies 2020.

Lyrics + kit expand the trio beyond power-trio default.
body.zh:
1952 年生。1974 接替 Rutsey。2112 至 Moving Pictures 定为 prog 鼓教学对象。2020 去世。

歌词+鼓组把三人组扩出 power-trio 默认。
